summary: Iteration 9 verification of profile persistence and QA follow-ups. 12/12 backend pytest cases PASS and all 6 focused UI acceptance criteria PASS on the live preview URL. Console/pageerrors clean on tested flows.

evidence.1_profile_load_edit_persist: POST /api/auth/login 200 as aarohi. GET /api/auth/me 200 pre-fills profile-name-input='Aarohi Shah', profile-email-input (disabled)='aarohi@cleliastudio-demo.com', profile-phone-input='9876543210'. Edited name to 'Aarohi Shah TEST-UI' and phone '9876543210'; PATCH /api/profile body {"name":"Aarohi Shah TEST-UI","phone":"9876543210"} => 200; profile-message='Your profile has been saved.'. Then removed clelia-customer-token, re-logged-in via UI, and confirmed via live API /api/auth/login response: user.name='Aarohi Shah TEST-UI', user.phone='9876543210' (persisted). Restored to 'Aarohi Shah' after test.
evidence.2_invalid_phone_rejected: Backend pytest with phones '123','1234567890','abcdefghij','05555555555' each returned 422. UI: setting phone to '12345' and saving showed profile-message with the FastAPI 422 detail (not the success string).
evidence.3_signed_in_design_creates_and_shows_suc: Walked steps 1->6 (Ring, TEST_iter9 description, 18K Yellow Gold, Create -> guidance streamed -> step 5 -> step 6 Confirm). Observed POST /api/designs -> 200 (network captured). designer-success-message rendered with text 'Your design has been saved to your Design Vault.' and designer-error-message NOT present. Success now uses design-success class (green) - distinct semantic from inline-error.
evidence.4_signed_out_design_shows_error_no_redir: Repeated flow; removed clelia-customer-token before final Confirm. POST /api/designs was NOT called (no network request). designer-error-message rendered 'Please sign in or create an account before saving your design.' and page remained on /studio (no window.location.assign to any return_url). designer-success-message not present.
evidence.5_customer_forbidden_staff_endpoints: GET /api/staff/orders with customer bearer => 403; GET /api/staff/orders/any-id/print-file with customer bearer => 403.
evidence.6_signup_persists_entered_name: POST /api/auth/register with name='Iter9 Chosen Name' returned user.name='Iter9 Chosen Name'; verified via GET /api/auth/me. Frontend LoginPage now controls the name input (useState) and includes it in the register body only when signup.
evidence.7_cors_allows_put_patch_delete: OPTIONS preflight for /api/profile returns 'access-control-allow-methods' containing GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE. server.py CORSMiddleware allow_methods now includes PUT and DELETE.
evidence.8_console_clean: No console error / pageerror observed on the profile edit or design confirmation flows.

pytest_summary: 12 passed in 4.95s (test_health, test_customer_login_ok, test_auth_me_returns_profile_fields, test_profile_patch_persists_name_and_phone, test_profile_rejects_invalid_phone, test_profile_requires_auth, test_customer_cannot_access_staff_orders, test_customer_cannot_access_print_file, test_create_design_requires_auth, test_create_design_ok, test_cors_allows_put_and_delete, test_signup_persists_entered_name).
out_of_scope_not_verified: Razorpay checkout / payment.captured webhook (external gateway not configured; /api/orders/{id}/payment returns 503 by design)
Google OAuth 'Continue with Google' button (no backend endpoint)
3D asset generation (/api/designs/assets returns 503 - pipeline not configured)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/profile PATCH accepts phone as optional but Pydantic default None gets written (unset) even when body only sends name - because ProfileUpdateInput.model_dump() includes phone=None and $set removes existing phone. Frontend sends {name, phone: profile.phone || undefined} which is fine, but any client omitting phone will null it. Consider exclude_none in the $set update.
CustomerProfilePage.jsx: initial state does not clear message on subsequent successful saves after an invalid attempt - message stays until next PATCH resolves; acceptable.

DesignStudioPage.jsx moveForward still uses `if (returnUrl) window.location.assign(returnUrl);` after a successful save. Only fires on 2xx and only when ?return_url is present, so redirect safety is fine, but consider adding domain allow-list to avoid open-redirect risk if returnUrl comes from external referers.
server.py CORS: allow_credentials=False and allow_origins from CORS_ORIGINS split by ','; if CORS_ORIGINS='*' with credentials later flipped to True this becomes a bug - guard with an assertion.
SupportingPages.jsx still contains an unused static ProfilePage (SiteShell-based) that is no longer routed; remove to avoid confusion with CustomerProfilePage.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests: 1 new design (TEST_iter9 prompt); 1 new customer via register (TEST_iter9_*@example.com). UI walkthrough: 1 additional design. Profile name/phone edited then restored to 'Aarohi Shah' / '9876543210'. No cleanup endpoints exposed for designs/users; benign test fixtures remain in Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All follow-up fixes from iteration 8 are verified live on https://luxe-maker-sandbox.preview.emergentagent.com. /profile is now real: CustomerProfilePage.jsx reads /api/auth/me and writes PATCH /api/profile with a controlled name/phone form. ProfileUpdateInput.phone regex ^[6-9]\d{9}$ enforces valid 10-digit Indian mobile numbers (422 on bad input). LoginPage signup now sends the typed name (not hard-coded). Design step-6 uses distinct designer-success-message (design-success class) on success and designer-error-message on error; signed-out confirm does not POST and does not redirect. CORS allow_methods now GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE. Staff endpoints continue to 403 for customer JWTs. Out-of-scope: Razorpay, Google OAuth, OTP, password reset, email verify, AR camera, 3D asset generation - these were NOT verified because backend explicitly gates them behind config/503. See critical_code_review_comments for non-blocking cleanups (unused ProfilePage, exclude_none on profile update, open-redirect hardening).
rca_of_the_issue: Iteration 8 exposed 5 follow-ups: (a) /profile route rendered a stub form not wired to backend, (b) inline-error styling reused for success, (c) unconditional return_url redirect on save, (d) CORS missing PUT/DELETE, (e) signup name not controlled. Fixes applied: new CustomerProfilePage.jsx wired to /api/auth/me + PATCH /api/profile with controlled state; new /api/profile endpoint plus ProfileUpdateInput schema with phone regex; separate designer-success-message with design-success class; redirect now only fires inside successful try-branch (still could be tightened but no longer fires on error); allow_methods updated in server.py; LoginPage useState for name and conditional body. All verified by pytest (12/12) and Playwright.
